title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
The patient presents for follow-up regarding management of type 2 diabetes.

History of Present Illness
The patient reports feeling generally well but notes recent persistent symptoms suggestive of poor glycemic management. He acknowledges difficulty adhering strictly to his dietary recommendations. Current labs show evidence of hyperglycemia. He continues on an oral hypoglycemic agent for his type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Medication List
Metformin

Exam
Vitals are stable. Physical exam is unremarkable, with no acute distress noted.

Assessment
The patient has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus with current hyperglycemia. Management of his T2DM remains the focus of care.

Plan
Continue the current oral hypoglycemic regimen. The patient was advised to focus on improving compliance with lifestyle modifications to help manage his hyperglycemia. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Diabetes documented as poorly controlled, out of control, or with hyperglycemia is coded to diabetes with hyperglycemia.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: Hyperglycemia is a complication with its own code.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
